title: Zesty Uruguayan Chicken Bowl
description: A tangy, crunchy, nut-free chicken bowl with yellow curry paste, kimchi, and fresh veggies, perfect for a cozy bento lunch.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add chicken pieces and sear until golden on all sides.
Stir in yellow curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer, and let cook for 8 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce thickens.
Meanwhile, toast a small amount of sesame seeds in a dry pan until golden (optional).
In a bowl, arrange cooked rice as the base.
Top the rice with the curry chicken and a handful of kimchi.
Scatter shredded carrot, cucumber slices, and pickled ginger over the bowl.
Drizzle lime juice and soy sauce across the ingredients.
Give the bowl a gentle toss, then serve chilled or at room temperature in a bento box.
